versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Snakes, lizards and toads acting in a woodland theatre who play dead: each fake death sets off death effects, then the unit gets up at 1 Health.
Deaths pay out in the fight or afterwards as permanent buffs, and two cards lend the trick to other tribes.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording pass: units are now Troupers, Dame Natrix's three deaths go in a fixed order and can't loop, and Žaltys, Wreath-Layer and the Juvenile Lead say plainly what they do.
A few small ideas taken: the Understudy plays dead when it steps in, the Matron's Hatchling skips a full hand, and Anguis's Tail size shows on his card.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording pass only: Anguis's Tails last one fight and buffs on one Tail stay on that Tail; the Villain can't murder himself.
Old Crest and Dame Natrix now say a doubled death repeats the same death, so build B reads as written.
